market_read.comment: Bias is open-to-close from the gap open, not vs. Tuesday's close (SPY 718.47, QQQ 637.80 in our bars). Expected opens: SPY about 700-708, QQQ about 615-624 (Tuesday's lows were 712.14 and 631.15, so both open well under them). The first 15-30 minutes can swing 2% either way, as on Nov 19, 20, 23 and 24; no call inside it. Set separately, per the coach: the gap comes mostly from chips, so QQQ (heavier in NVDA/AVGO/AMD/MU) keeps a slight down lean on a second leg of the same unwind, while SPY's gap of ~2% to below Tuesday's low has been partly bought on recent gap-downs (Nov 24 SPY +0.51% open to close) and pre-holiday sessions lean firm. Both are close to coin flips. Tripwire: at 10:30, if SPY is above its opening 30-min high, the SPY up lean is confirmed and QQQ down should be dropped; if QQQ is below its opening 30-min low, the QQQ down lean holds and the SPY up lean should be dropped.
